spans.excerpt: The claim ... is refuted when any finite observation is less than or equal to zero.
A refutation must expose at least one source observation as a witness.
A positive mean establishes only the aggregate claim, not the universal claim.
An empty dataset, a missing value, or a non-numeric observation makes the computation unavailable rather than false.

notes: The input is a reusable review rule and contains no task observation values.
Source locator schema, duplicate identifier behavior, positive verdict label, and witness ordering are candidate policy choices.
